skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or the fractional parts of mixed numbers) that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two unlike-denominator fractions and rewrite each as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup for negative fraction result
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative value, convert one unit from the whole-number part into d/d and add it to the minuend's fraction before subtracting again (applied repeatedly if still negative).

skills.name: Simplify fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Subtract whole-number parts
skills.definition: Isolate and subtract the integer components of the two quantities, treating a bare whole number or pure fraction as having an explicit 0 fraction or 0 whole part when needed.

skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike fractions and convert both to equivalent fractions expressed over that denominator.

skills.name: Common-Denominator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) once they share a common denominator.

skills.name: Whole-Number Part Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of two mixed numbers or integers, treating a pure fraction or plain integer as having a 0 or absent whole/fraction part as needed.

skills.name: Borrowing for Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: When subtracting fractional parts produces a negative value, regroup one unit from the whole part (as denominator/denominator) and redo the fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to its lowest terms (or convert an improper/zero result into whole or mixed form) as a final step.

skills.name: Improper Fraction-Part Normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose stated fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by moving whole units out of the fraction before performing the subtraction.

skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Numerator/Whole Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators (and whole-number parts) once operands share a common denominator.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms when it is not already fully reduced.

skills.name: Mixed Number Decomposition/Recombination
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into whole and fractional parts, compute each part's difference, and recombine them into a final mixed-number or integer answer.

skills.name: Borrow/Regroup
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as d/d) from the whole part and retry, repeating if necessary.

skills.name: Whole-Number Placeholder Rewrite
skills.definition: Rewrite a bare whole-number operand as 'whole + 0/d' so it structurally matches the other mixed-number operand before subtracting.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fraction parts of mixed numbers) once they share a common denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator for two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Borrow across whole/fraction
skills.definition: When subtracting the fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and add it to the fraction part before subtracting again.

skills.name: Whole/fraction decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into its whole and fractional components (or treat a bare whole number as whole + 0/denominator) so that whole parts and fraction parts can be subtracted independently.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction (pure fractions)
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly when both operands are pure fractions (no whole-number part) sharing a common denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert the fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole/fraction decomposition subtraction
skills.definition: Separate a mixed or whole number into whole and fractional parts and subtract the whole parts together with the (same-denominator) fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrow regrouping
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative value, borrow one unit from the whole part (rewritten as denominator/denominator) and redo the fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Improper fractional-part normalization
skills.definition: Convert a given mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into proper form by moving the excess into the whole part before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to its lowest-terms equivalent when the raw subtraction result is not already fully reduced.
